items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: since so few of those people in Fess's family did anything for him to begin with... when Fess needed people, they were nowhere to be found.

ctx.x: Okay. And if he does, you know, I mean, you know, I, I, I just feel like he's, he's setting himself up here. As far as I'm concerned, he's just an opportunist. He's going to milk whatever he can and, and, and feed these people to fare thee well. And then he's going to be gone, you know. But, uh, hey, since so few of those people in Fess's family did anything for him to begin with, it couldn't happen to a better bunch. You know, this is almost retribution. Uh, because when Fess needed people, they were nowhere to…
You brought up, you brought up somebody I wanted to talk about. You brought up Al Young.
